This indicates a lack of precision in interpreting search results and distinguishing between relevant data files and scholarly articles. While the system eventually moved towards more targeted navigation within the genome browsers (Steps 33, 44, 48), the initial and repeated diversions into irrelevant academic papers reduced its overall efficiency.
